Name: Accessible Cutscene Maps
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
[size=3]Tired of not being able to access maps shown only during cutscenes? Have you always wanted to go back to Haley's darkroom? Well I've got the mod for you!

This mod allows you to enter the following rooms after viewing the cutscene they are first seen in:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Haley's Darkroom[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Maru's Basement[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Marnie's Barn[/size][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Accessible Cutscene Maps
Manifest.Description: Allows you to revisit rooms shown in cutscenes, such as Haley's darkroom and Maru's basement!
Manifest.Author: Nullnnow
